dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: I am a member of the Kujou Clan and one of the officials of the Tenryou Commission. It's obvious that I should wholeheartedly support the decision of our Almighty Shogun, but...

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: I've seen the difficult lives led by our people nowadays from the reports I've received recently. The Sakoku Decree and Vision Hunt Decree... are they really beneficial to our future?

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: If the people aren't living happy lives, what's the point of living in an eternal state?

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: Perhaps I'm just overthinking and worrying too much...
